stem: Benito needs a better transition between the fourth paragraph (sentences 16–19) and the fifth paragraph (sentences 20–24). Which sentence can replace sentence 20 to help improve this transition?

options.label: A
options.text: First, Aunt Rosa began to carefully observe our surroundings.

options.label: B
options.text: Aunt Rosa was my mom’s younger sister who had come for a weekend visit.

options.label: C
options.text: Next, I looked around and wondered how long this rain was going to last.

options.label: D
options.text: Hiking is fun but may not be the best activity in a rainstorm.
